notes: The published scope explicitly uses a constitutional mixed-economy market-capitalist variant. Economic mechanisms rest on ownership and allocation doctrine; noneconomic answers are low-confidence institutional estimates, not necessary characteristics of every capitalist regime. No religious prerequisite is imposed. Checked all 240 literal statements and agreement directions, the 15 independent axis briefs, counter-evidence, source references, period, metadata and inferred uncertainty. All 240 responses remain conservatively marked inferred; exact IDs are in the separate review. Technical validation cannot certify the historical or political estimates. Similarity decisions are added only after checking calculated neighbours.
